error.summary: Vector-blind shortcuts answer all five delivered batch questions. Three complete source profiles are missing, and explicit subtraction parameters can produce a wrong key. Package files remain unchanged. Full report: review.json.

source_analysis.skill: Solve for one scalar coefficient in a vector linear combination.
reasoning_steps: Determine a scalar from a nonzero component and verify every component.
Select the scalar or No solution from five radio choices.
invariants: One unknown scalar and equal-dimensional column vectors.
Basic vector addition, subtraction and scalar multiplication.
Preserve component consistency checking and source workload.
permitted_variations: Change coordinates, scalar values, signs, unknown labels and eligible answer-bank relationships.
Vary homogeneous versus explicit-target equations without automatically fixing consistency.
source_refs: lesson 17592186120045 step 17592186120673: isolate the s term using vector addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication

source_replay.details: Nine profiles replay their full mathematical banks and solution matrices. Three complete rated source cases have no profile. The incomplete unrated source is documented separately.

math.details: All 54 fresh samples and five runner records pass independent arithmetic checks. Explicit subtraction parameters c=2 produce an inconsistent prompt keyed as 2; the normal sampler excludes this parameter.

variety.details: Label/bank signatures predict easy answers, while homogeneous profiles always answer No solution. Two affected stored generated questions were reproduced.

scope.details: Normal outputs preserve one scalar, dimensions 2–4, basic vector operations and five-choice radio responses.

grading.details: Native grading correctly accepts 123 independently verified selections and rejects 492 distractors. Includes delivered records and applicable counterfactuals. The boundary failure is an authored-key defect.

rendering.details: Fourteen actual-UI previews pass rendering checks. Five representative screenshots were visually inspected.

packaging.details: Exact dependency versions match. Deterministic replay, relocation and external output pass. Package hashes remain unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Vector-blind cues answer 54/54 fresh samples and 5/5 runner records. Defects survive delivery filtering. Valid role changes are excluded from normal sampling; selection assumptions and limits are recorded.

findings.description: Visible variable/bank signatures answer every runner question without inspecting vectors: l with No solution selects the only negative value; l with numeric-only choices selects the second-largest; h selects the largest. Other easy subgroups also have perfect rank/sign rules.
findings.reproduction: Run the context Python on audit.py and acceptance-tests.py under evidence_root. Minimal runner case b713577b-6986-5a32-9f22-4f4d35b1455e, seed 2406259497: l; choices 1,-1,1/2,0,No solution. Choosing the only negative value succeeds. All five batch records survive check_delivery.py.
findings.requested_change: Revise normal scalar/sign domains and distractor-bank construction so visible signatures do not determine the correct value. Preserve source replay and regenerate a batch that passes conditional shortcut probes. Option shuffling alone is insufficient.

findings.description: Every homogeneous profile answers No solution: 18/18 fresh samples and 17/17 delivered controls. Two stored generated questions reproduce this weakness.

Change only u[0] to 1: k=-6 becomes valid, but explicit generation raises AssertionError. generated-records.json reproduces stored UUIDs 036a544e-adcf-5604-8565-d9b2d689152b and e5e9f97a-8dbd-5e5f-adc8-0ae163476518.
findings.requested_change: Decouple zero-RHS wording from consistency. Include justified same-method decision cases and derive banks and explanations from component consistency while retaining the source contradiction families.

findings.requested_change: Add replay support for all three complete captured cases, including full banks and worked solutions, and validate their variations independently.

findings.description: The subtraction profile accepts c=2, computes b=2a-su, but displays a-ju=b and stores j=2. This is an explicit-parameter validation defect outside normal sampling.
findings.reproduction: Run audit.py then run-native.py. q-34241, seed 64193, parameters a=[0,-1,1], u=[-2,1,0], c=2, s=2, letter=j produces b=[4,-4,2]. The displayed third component requires 1=2, yet native grading accepts stored answer 2. Retained in boundary-subtraction-c2.json.
findings.requested_change: Enforce c=1 within subtraction parameter validation, or consistently render and solve the general coefficient. Retain the strict failing rejection test; no engine change is needed.
